CustomField.description: When true, marks this template as requiring payment, gating submission completion behind a paid step (used with the Price Book and payment integration). Drives whether the form enforces a payment before the submission is treated as complete.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if users must pay to complete this form. Set the Price Book to control pricing. Leave unchecked for forms that don't collect payment.
CustomField.label: Payment Required
